label: DESI DR2 BAO consistency with DR1, SDSS and supernova distances
summary: The retained DESI DR2 source reports that its BAO results are consistent with DESI DR1 and SDSS, and that their distance-redshift relationship matches recent supernova compilations over the same redshift range.

sources.title: DESI DR2 Results II: Measurements of Baryon Acoustic Oscillations and Cosmological Constraints
